correspondences.notes: BIDS 1.11.2 has no NODDI suffixes; the export map uses a non-BIDS suffix ICVF.

brainlife.desc: NODDI fit (AMICO) as NIfTI maps: neurite density (NDI), orientation dispersion (ODI), isotropic volume fraction (ISOVF) and main direction.
brainlife.name: neuro/noddi

original.desc: NODDI: Neurite Orientation Dispersion and Density Imaging. 4D image with ICVF, OD, ISOVF; where ICVF is the intracellular volume fraction (also known as NDI), OD is the orientation dispersion (the variance of the Bingham; also known as ODI) and ISOVF is the isotropic component volume fraction (also known as IVF).

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Tract profiles, cortical mapping, connectome weights and ROI statistics of microstructure.

**Not for:** Trusting NDI or ISOVF from single-shell fits; only ODI is reliable there.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 19 Apps, output of 5 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.noddi.json

identifying_risks: NIfTI headers or metadata may carry subject codes or dates
Rare lesions or anomalies can be recognisable in small samples
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level processed diffusion MRI without direct identifiers.
sharing_cautions: Share with coded subject IDs under a data use agreement
Check headers and metadata for identifiers before release
tier_conditions: Tier 1 only as a group-averaged template
Tier 4 if used as features for predicting cognitive or clinical states
